current: 15.3  	Data Security.  Each Party shall maintain a written information security program that includes administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the nature and sensitivity of the data processed under this Agreement. In the event of any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction of research data (a "Security Incident"), the affected Party shall notify the other Party within forty-eight (48) hours of discovering such incident and shall cooperate in investigating and remedying the Security Incident.
final: 15.3   Data Security. Each Party shall maintain a written information security program that includes administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the nature and sensitivity of the data processed under this Agreement. In the event of any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction of research data (a "Security Incident"), the affected Party shall: (a) provide preliminary written notice to the other Party within seventy-two (72) hours after discovering the Security Incident, with sufficient detail for the other Party to assess its own regulatory exposure, including the known nature and scope of the incident, the categories of data affected, and known containment measures; (b) provide a full written disclosure within seven (7) days after forensic confirmation, supplemented as additional material facts become known; (c) if the affected Party is Party B and the Security Incident requires physical investigation of closed-network hardware, use an extended preliminary notice window only to the extent reasonably necessary to complete that investigation, provided that Party B identifies a point of contact and an estimated timeline within the seventy-two (72) hour standard window; and (d) disclose within seventy-two (72) hours after discovery any unlogged access event identified after the fact, including the date discovered, the affected systems or data, and the known or reasonably suspected scope of access. Each Party shall cooperate in investigating and remedying the Security Incident.
